hints.title: Quadratic first
hints.body: For each position, ask for the longest rising chain that ends there. Looking back at every earlier position gives a correct `O(n^2)` solution.

hints.title: Better bookkeeping
hints.body: Keep an array `tails` where `tails[k]` is the smallest possible final value of a rising chain with length `k + 1` among the elements processed so far.

hints.title: Smaller endings are better
hints.body: A smaller final value leaves more room for future elements. When a new value arrives, replace the first tail that is greater than or equal to it. If no tail is that large, the value extends the longest chain.
